newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CVRD bid spec not ready-minister.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CVRD bid spec not ready-minister.

text.p: Brazilian Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said the government was in a final phase of preparing the bid specifications for state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD).
Kandir told reporters before attending a Senate committee session that he expected the National Privatization Council (CND) to meet on March 5.
"We are in a phase of finalizing the preparation of the tender details for CVRD," he said.
Kandir said he was attending a session of the Senate's Infra-Structure Committee to inform senators of "progress" on the bid specifications.
"I am here just to present some of the ideas in the bid specifications and to listen to (senators)," Kandir said.
The privatization of CVRD is due to kick off in April with an initial block sale of 40 to 45 percent of voting shares.
Officials previously said the bid specifications might be made public Friday but would not include Vale's minimum price nor auction date.
